ironautospell.title: Spell Relay
ironautospell.name: Combo name
ironautospell.click_slots: Click a book slot to append; hover for spell
ironautospell.no_book: Equip a spellbook in the Curios spellbook slot. Disabled slots are empty, locked or merged with other equipment.
ironautospell.policy_hint: Cooldown policy only. Missing mana, interruptions and invalid slots stop the sequence.
ironautospell.saved: Saved. F9 starts/stops this combo. Rebind in Controls.
ironautospell.invalid_sequence: Use slots 1..256 separated by commas; at most 64 steps.
ironautospell.save_error: Could not save; check logs and config directory permissions.
ironautospell.status.done: Combo finished: %s cast, %s skipped on cooldown.
ironautospell.status.stopped: Sequence stopped; an already started cast finishes normally.
ironautospell.status.empty: Empty combo. Press F8 to configure.
ironautospell.status.busy: Already casting. Finish the current spell first.
ironautospell.status.bad_slot: Book slot %s is empty, locked or merged with another item.
ironautospell.status.continuous: Book slot %s is a continuous channel; not supported in sequences yet.
ironautospell.status.invalid: Stopped: invalid slot, another cast, or an active recast.
ironautospell.status.cooldown_stop: Stopped: next spell is on cooldown.
ironautospell.status.cooldown_wait: Combo %s/%s: waiting for cooldown; F9 stops.
ironautospell.status.timeout_start: Stopped: no start acknowledgement after 30s. Check conditions/network.
ironautospell.status.timeout_cast: Stopped: timed out waiting for cast completion.
ironautospell.status.interrupted: Stopped: the current cast was interrupted.
ironautospell.status.left_world: Stopped: player died or left the world.
ironautospell.status.book_changed: Stopped: the spellbook or its spells changed.
